label: PF Backlog 244
title: Logs/observability SSOT: one writer (core/log_router) + one JSONL schema + one tree + one event stream
body: Today ~20 log/event/state files in 4 trees and two event streams; convention paths absent; backend log in data/logs. Make core/log_router the ONLY writer; one schema; one tree; merge streams; enforce rotation. Extends BI-0153. See docs/LOGS-AND-OBSERVABILITY.md.
_note: Partial: events.emit creates dir; event_bus mirrors project events into canonical stream; SSE reads canonical per-project stream. Remaining: log_router as sole writer (route per-agent logs through it), one JSONL schema, retention/rotation.
